text:
Which statement explains why ethanoic acid is saturated?
A
The molecule dissociates completely in water.
B
There is a carbon–oxygen double bond in the molecule.
C
The carbon–carbon bond in the molecule is a single bond.
D
All the carbon–hydrogen bonds in the molecule are single bonds.

options.label: A
options.text: The molecule dissociates completely in water.

options.label: B
options.text: There is a carbon–oxygen double bond in the molecule.

options.label: C
options.text: The carbon–carbon bond in the molecule is a single bond.

options.label: D
options.text: All the carbon–hydrogen bonds in the molecule are single bonds.
